verdict.rationale: A UI framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship a natural-language interface, such as an AI assistant in its tooling, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party way to operate Vue through natural-language commands. The llms.txt documentation bundle only feeds docs to external LLMs, which is an adjacent building block rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
